paragraphs.text: The proposer acknowledges the requirements outlined in the RFP and confirms compliance with the specified standards and conditions. The proposal includes a comprehensive response to the requested lots, detailing the scope of work and the specific components covered under each lot. The proposer ensures that all deliverables align with the Owner's requirements and the independent design consultant's guidelines.

The proposer recognizes the Owner's role in providing major equipment for installation and integration. The proposal outlines the approach to integrating Owner-furnished equipment into the overall data center design, ensuring compatibility and seamless operation within the proposed lots.

The proposer confirms the inclusion of training for the Owner's operators and maintainers as part of the deliverables for each lot. This training will cover the operation, maintenance, and safety procedures relevant to the equipment and systems provided.

The proposer notes that the Owner will provide the Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and energy price during the dialogue phase. These values will be utilized to calculate the total cost of ownership, ensuring accurate and transparent cost analysis.
